summaryZh: Breen Church 实验室研究调控生殖神经内分泌激素活动的神经回路的发育、组织与激活，涵盖正常生理与应激状态及早期生命经历对生育能力的影响。负责人所述研究项目采用小鼠模型、遗传学和神经解剖学操作。
researchQuestions: 控制生殖神经内分泌激素活动的神经回路，在正常及应激条件下如何发育、组织与激活？
methods: 小鼠模型（负责人研究项目）
遗传学操作（负责人研究项目）
神经解剖学操作（负责人研究项目）

evidence.quote: The overarching goal of the Breen Church Laboratory is to understand the development, organization and activation of neural circuits that control reproductive neuroendocrine hormone activity in males and females in both normal physiologic conditions and in conditions of disrupted homeostasis, also known as stress.
The Breen Church Lab is Located on the third floor of the Leichtag Family Biomedical Research Building in the School of Medicine, on the La Jolla campus of UCSD.
Early life programming of delayed or deficient fertility.

The overarching goal of the Breen Church Laboratory is to understand the development, organization and activation of neural circuits that control reproductive neuroendocrine hormone activity in males and females in both normal physiologic conditions and in conditions of disrupted homeostasis, also known as stress.

Applying the fundamentals of hypothesis-driven science, my current research program employs state-of-the-art chemogenic, genetic, and neuroanatomical manipulations using mouse models to understand of how stress-activated neural circuits elicit disrupted reproduction and fertility.
